title: ADTGuard: Adaptive Depth-Time Safeguard for Streaming Inference in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate fluent responses to diverse user requests, yet streaming may expose users to harmful content before generation is complete. Existing guardrails face two limitations in this setting. First, post-hoc moderation at response or chunk boundaries delays intervention, risking harmful exposure when content is released before verification. Second, even with token-level detection, coarse response-level supervision does not specify when harmful content begins, while fixed-layer readouts may miss relevant safety signals at other depths. To address these limitations, we introduce ADTGuard, which checks each token before release, progressively refines token-level training targets, and adapts layer selection to the current prefix. translated_title: ADTGuard：面向大语言模型流式推理的自适应深度-时间安全防护机制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）能够对多样化的用户请求生成流畅的回复，然而流式输出可能在生成完成之前就让用户接触到有害内容。现有的防护机制在这一场景下存在两个局限。第一，在回复或分块边界进行的事后审核会延迟干预，当内容在验证之前被释放时存在有害暴露的风险。第二，即使采用词元级检测，粗糙的回复级监督也无法指明有害内容从何时开始，而固定的层读取方式可能会错过其他深度层级上的相关安全信号。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了ADTGuard，它在每个词元释放之前进行检查，逐步细化词元级训练目标，并根据当前前缀自适应地选择层。ADTGuard通过深度-时间安全动力学（DTSD）对深度和时间两个维度上的风险进行建模，该机制在每个词元处整合跨层的安全证据，并利用这些证据引导风险累积。
tldr: ADTGuard提出了一种自适应深度-时间安全防护机制，通过在每个词元释放前整合跨层安全证据并建模风险随深度与时间的动态累积，实现了大语言模型流式推理中的实时有害内容检测。
en_tdlr: ADTGuard introduces an adaptive depth-time safeguard that checks each token before release by integrating cross-layer safety evidence and modeling risk accumulation across depth and time, enabling real-time detection of harmful content during streaming inference in LLMs.
